parameters.description: Unique company identifier associated with the Procore User Account.

get.description: Get Values for Change Event Settings

budget_rom_source_for_in_scope.description: Source value used to calculate the budget ROM (rough order of magnitude) for change event line items marked 'In Scope'.

budget_rom_source_for_out_of_scope.description: Source value used to calculate the budget ROM for change event line items marked 'Out of Scope'.

budget_rom_source_for_tbd_scope.description: Source value used to calculate the budget ROM for change event line items marked 'TBD' (scope not yet determined).

celi_prefill_automation.description: When true, auto-populates Budget Code, Vendor, and Contract on new change event line items.

change_order_value_source.description: Source value used when creating or updating Commitment Change Orders / Potential Change Orders from change events.

copy_rfq_attachments_to_commitment_cos.description: When true, copies RFQ attachments onto generated Commitment Change Orders / Potential Change Orders.

copy_rfq_attachments_to_prime_cos.description: When true, copies RFQ attachments onto generated Prime Change Orders / Potential Change Orders.

display_revenue_detail_columns.description: When true, displays the revenue ROM, latest price, latest cost, and over/under columns on the change events grid.

display_spend_quantity_columns.description: When true, displays the unit of measure, revenue quantity, revenue unit cost, ROM unit quantity, and ROM unit cost columns on the change events grid.

prevent_both_prime_cos_and_budget_change.description: When true, prevents a single change event line item from generating both a Budget Change and a Prime Potential Change Order.

sync_wbs_code.description: When true, keeps the budget (WBS) code in sync between a change event line item and its linked change order / commitment line items.

x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v2.0/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/change_event_settings")

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))

x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"settings\":{\"budget_rom_source_for_in_scope\":\"cost\",\"budget_rom_source_for_out_of_scope\":\"revenue\",\"budget_rom_source_for_tbd_scope\":\"none\",\"celi_prefill_automation\":true,\"change_order_value_source\":\"latest_cost\",\"copy_rfq_attachments_to_commitment_cos\":false,\"copy_rfq_attachments_to_prime_cos\":true,\"display_revenue_detail_columns\":true,\"display_spend_quantity_columns\":true,\"prevent_both_prime_cos_and_budget_changes\":false,\"sync_wbs_code\":true}}"

headers = { 'content-type': "application/json" }

conn.request("PATCH", "/rest/v2.0/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/change_event_settings", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
